sources.author: byehi98
patch_list: Every "watch ad" button pays out immediately without playing an ad: the shop reward grants 2000 coins and 50 diamonds, and the in-level revive button revives you. Works offline and can be tapped repeatedly.

The four shop buttons grant their item directly instead of opening Google Play billing: 20,000 coins, 2,000 diamonds, Remove Ads and the Halo pack. No payment sheet appears and the purchases are saved normally.

Makes the game start up ad-free: banners, interstitials and the app-open ad never load, and the shop already shows "Remove Ads" as owned. The game's own ad-free flag is set before Unity starts, so the setting survives restarts and clearing…
